title: Studio Uno '66
scene: RAI Studio Uno 1966 / Italian television orchestral pop; Ri-Fi
notes: Morricone's Se telefonando crowns a theatrical orchestral TV-pop set with standards and ballads.

title: Dedicato a mio padre
scene: PDU independent Lugano studio / vocal jazz and transatlantic standards
notes: Independent-label debut embraces jazz standards, De André, American balladry and multilingual orchestral elegance.

title: Canzonissima '68
scene: 1968 RAI Saturday-evening Canzonissima / PDU televised orchestral pop
notes: Canzonissima themes meet dramatic Italian ballads, Brazilian playfulness and American soul adaptations.

title: Mina (1971)
scene: PDU La Basilica 1971 / Italian orchestral pop, early Pino Presti era
notes: The monkey-cover album bridges Martelli and Presti, with monumental ballads and refined pop-soul.
